MRL.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Movement Limiter
MRL.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Rate-limit interactive token movement initiated by restricted users.
MRL.Settings.MovementSpeed.Name: Movement Speed (squares/sec)
MRL.Settings.MovementSpeed.Hint: The number of grid spaces a token may travel per real second. Scene distance units do not change this value.
MRL.Settings.RestrictedRoles.Name: Restricted Roles
MRL.Settings.RestrictedRoles.Hint: Choose which user roles are subject to the movement limiter.
MRL.Settings.DisableDuringCombat.Name: Disable Movement Limiter During Combat
MRL.Settings.DisableDuringCombat.Hint: When enabled, movement in a started combat encounter is handled normally by Foundry.
MRL.Settings.ShowNotification.Name: Show Movement-Limit Warnings
MRL.Settings.ShowNotification.Hint: Show non-critical warnings when a movement-limit request is rejected. Critical errors are always shown.
MRL.Settings.DebugLogging.Name: Debug Logging
MRL.Settings.DebugLogging.Hint: Log movement measurements, effective speed, timings, and decisions to the browser console.
MRL.TokenConfig.Override.Name: Token Override
MRL.TokenConfig.Override.Hint: Override the world movement-speed setting for this token.
MRL.TokenConfig.CustomSpeed.Name: Custom Speed (squares/sec)
MRL.TokenConfig.CustomSpeed.Hint: Used only when Token Override is set to Custom speed.
MRL.Notifications.NoActiveGM: Movement limited — an active GM is required.
MRL.Notifications.Stale: Movement cancelled — the token position changed.
MRL.Notifications.Paused: Movement cancelled while the game is paused.
